title: chore: add test for cross-platform
author: cscnk52
summary: Runs the Rust, JS and WASM CI jobs on a ubuntu/macos/windows matrix, switches `cargo fmt` to `--check`, installs binaryen via a third-party action, and bundles unrelated rustfmt/unused-import cleanups. It expects Windows to fail until #1247/#1248 (both still open) land, and now conflicts with master's workflow (node 24, AST check, toolchain 1.96).
evidence: Current .github/workflows/test.yml on master differs (node-version 24, `Check generated TypeScript types` step from #1407; rust-toolchain.toml now 1.96.0 vs PR's 1.92.0 + wasm target). #1247 (Windows hash stability) and #1248 (color rounding) are open. No maintainer comments (only CodSpeed bot).
decision: Do you want CI to run all three jobs on macOS and Windows (about 3x CI minutes, and it requires merging #1247/#1248 first), or only e.g. the Rust tests on Windows, or not at all?
